documentType.name: supplier invoice
documentType.preamble: This is an invoice issued by a supplier. It may be a native PDF or a scan. Amounts may appear in several places (line items, subtotal, tax, total); the total payable is the one that matters.

fields.name: supplierName
fields.promptFragment: The legal name of the business issuing the invoice, as printed in the header or remittance section. Not the customer's name.

fields.name: supplierTaxId
fields.promptFragment: The supplier's tax or business registration number exactly as printed (for example ABN, VAT or EIN). Return null if none is printed.

fields.name: invoiceNumber
fields.promptFragment: The invoice number or reference. Not a purchase order number, account number or customer number.

fields.name: invoiceDate
fields.promptFragment: The date the invoice was issued, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Not the due date or the delivery date.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.promptFragment: The payment due date in ISO format. If only payment terms are given (for example 'Net 30') return null rather than calculating a date.

fields.name: purchaseOrder
fields.promptFragment: The customer purchase order number referenced on the invoice, if any.

fields.name: currency
fields.promptFragment: The currency of the amounts. Use Other if it is stated but not in the list. Return null if no currency is shown.

fields.name: totalAmount
fields.promptFragment: The total amount payable including tax, as a number without currency symbols. If a credit or amount already paid is deducted, return the final balance due.

fields.name: taxAmount
fields.promptFragment: The total tax amount as a number. Return null if tax is not shown separately; do not calculate it.

fields.name: isCreditNote
fields.promptFragment: True if the document is a credit note or adjustment rather than a request for payment.
